summary: A London firm covering immigration, family and property across several offices is a strength, but counters that read zero and a testimonials section with no testimonials appear to cost you enquiries.

findings.problem: The counters appear to read '0 +' for free consultations, years of experience and successful cases, and the Testimonials section appears to be only a link with no testimonials.
findings.cost: Zeros on your strongest proof points make the claims look false.
findings.fix: Live counters and visible client reviews.

findings.problem: The Careers link appears to point to 'http://careers', and Services and Careers menu items appear to have no destination.
findings.cost: Visitors click menu items that do nothing.

findings.problem: The Manchester office appears to list the same London phone number and the same fax as every other office, and Harrow appears with no details.
findings.cost: Clients cannot tell which office to contact.

findings.problem: The word 'Turnstile' and a stray character appear visibly on both forms, the consultation form appears to have no surname field, and tenant eviction and sports law each appear on two different page addresses.
findings.cost: Visible code text and duplicate pages look careless and split your search ranking.
findings.fix: Clean forms and one page per service.

redesign: Verified office details, clean forms and one page per service.
